subject: Renewal kick-off: evidence, log retention, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Danielle Reed <danielle.reed@ascend-retail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: AuditOps <auditops@ascend-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal evidence + capacity uplift (Q1 recert)

Karthik —

We’re kicking off the renewal conversation for Ascend Retail. Two asks from my side to keep the renewal on track:

1) SOC recertification / evidence: our internal audit team needs a snapshot of your current evidence set for the past 12 months, plus a few specific artifacts:
   - audit logs (application & infrastructure) with retention metadata
   - current SOC 2 report (if available) and control-matrix mapping
   - retention policy and any recent retention-policy changes

2) Capacity/terms: usage has grown faster than forecast. We’d like to discuss a +50% capacity uplift (GPU-hours and token throughput) and a 12→24 month term for predictable pricing.

Target timeline: audit wants the evidence bundle and retention snapshot by Jan 26 so the recert can be scheduled for early Feb. Can you confirm owners and an upload location for artifacts? Also please flag any items that require an NDA/BAA update.

Thanks,
Danielle
VP, Infrastructure & Security
Ascend Retail

--
attachments: none (initial request)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Danielle Reed <danielle.reed@ascend-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence + capacity uplift (Q1 recert)

Danielle —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can support the Jan 26 deadline. Proposed plan:

- Owners: Marissa (Security & Compliance pack) and Grace (Ops for logs/retention extract). I’ll own commercial (capacity/term).
- Evidence upload: we’ll provide a single zipped bundle and a GDrive index. I’ll send the HubSpot deal and DocuSign items once we align on term.
- Capacity: I’ll put together a short uplift worksheet for GPU-hours and expected steady-state throughput for the 24‑month term.

Quick questions:
- Do you need raw syslogs or just parsed audit logs with retention headers?
- Any specific control mapping template you prefer for the SOC matrix?

Next steps: I’ll schedule a 30‑minute sync for Friday to run through the checklist and sign-off owners. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

attachments: capacity-change-MAP_v2.xlsx (will attach in final bundle)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence + capacity uplift (Q1 recert)

On Wed, Jan 13, 2027 at 10:02 AM, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Quick questions:
> - Do you need raw syslogs or just parsed audit logs with retention headers?

Danielle / team —

For audit purposes we recommend the following deliverables (we’ll produce these and drop into the shared Drive):

- Parsed audit logs with retention headers (CSV export): includes timestamp, user-id, request-path, response-code, and retention_flag
- System event stream (last 12 months): gzipped JSONL (we can provide samples if they need raw format)
- Retention policy snapshot: PDF (see attached snapshot)
- Control mapping: we’ll provide a control-matrix mapping to your SOC 2 template (NIST-CC equivalent fields)

I’ve attached a retention snapshot that shows our current default retention windows and the changes we made in 2026. We’ll also include a README with extraction queries and estimated volume.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--

Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence + capacity uplift (Q1 recert)

Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the plan. A couple of clarifications from the audit team:

- Checklist: please include a signed AUP and the latest encryption-at-rest configuration screenshots.
- Evidence upload: use the secure upload link we provided (we’ll accept the zip & GDrive index).
- BAAs: if there were changes to how PII is processed, we’ll need an updated BAA — please route to legal.
- Deadline: Jan 26 is firm. If you can’t make the full bundle, upload the control-matrix and retention snapshot by Jan 20 and we can buffer the rest.

DocuSign for the updated Data Processing Addendum: https://docusign.com/s/ascend-rdw-dpa
Secure upload portal (ascend): https://secure.ascend-retail.com/upload/rdw-renewal-2027

Thanks,
AuditOps Team
Ascend Retail
